title_as_printed: Measured and calculated water content of MIX1 at 150 C
gas_composition_source: Table 4.14 (p.172 / pdf 203): 'Compositions of the CO2-rich fluids entitled MIX1 and MIX 6 in terms of mole percent'; certified by supplier (Air Products); dry-gas feed composition, not the equilibrium gas-phase composition
pressure_note: equilibrium cell pressure; uncertainty not printed in this table; absolute or gauge not stated

value.what: water content of the MIX1 gas phase in equilibrium with water, 'ppm' (basis not printed; see notes)

conversion_needs: ppm to mole fraction once basis settled
multicomponent gas: builder decides scope (contains components outside the seven gases)
notes: GC measurement (high-temperature set-up, as Table 4.7). Header 'Uncertainty' sits above 'ppm' in the printed header but the entries are printed in %; '%' moved to the header. Rows printed in decreasing pressure order. Multicomponent CO2-rich gas; gas key lists the components with nonzero mole percent. 2026-10-11 coordinator: 'ppm' read as ppm by mole. Check against other laboratories in the database at the same T and P (interpolated in ln P): Table 4.13 CO2 over water, 100 and 150 C, 16-138 bar: ratio Teymouri/others 0.79-0.99 (Hou 2013b, Zawisza 1981, Caumon 2016, Tabasinejad 2011, King 1971); a mass basis would make the mole fractions 2.44 times larger (ratio about 2-2.4). Table 4.2 CH4 over water, 5 and 15 C: ratio 0.91-1.12 against Chapoy 2003/2005. Same instruments as Tables 4.4-4.7, printed 'y_w - ppm' and 'ppmV'.
